summary: Controlled migration delivery for the verified snapshot-chain audit capability and the product-side model-final artifact boundary from the read-only Candidate 2 worktree, combined with the existing adaptive-remediation delivery. The migrated product patch is validated against the authoritative pinned input/repository tree; lifecycle and runtime harness changes remain sibling-only and are not represented as Builder Candidate provenance.
commands: python3 -m agentloop.candidate_adapter --source-repository <authoritative input/repository> --candidate delivery --build-dir <task-local evidence> --runtime-python <task-local Python 3.12>
compatibility_notes: The repository-relative patch applies once with git apply --check and git apply against the authoritative pinned input/repository tree.
Targeted product compilation passes for the materialized Candidate tree; the product entry remains MasteryPathCapability.run.
The new chain-audit tool is registered in both MASTERY_TOOL_NAMES and MASTERY_TOOL_TYPES, and its focused tests cover verified read-only audit plus stale/foreign/fork rejection.

The common AgentLoop final-result seam now persists the exact model-final JSON to DEEPTUTOR_AGENT_RESULT only when the evaluator opts in; malformed and wrong-case output is rejected without synthesis.
limitations: The patch was generated from the read-only candidate2-work migration input at commit 853e0bfa437b81aaa167dacc30f5b2a6340d04db; it is not evidence of a same-session Builder Candidate 2 and must not be used as formal Candidate 2 provenance.

The direct writer probe is provider-free and exercises the materialized product method in the task-local Python environment; it does not prove a real lower model reached the product final-result seam.
No model-authored Agent-loop Result, formal six-hidden result, independent Code score, or aggregation is claimed; no expensive broker/formal run was started in this task.
